items.name: Cerrado del Águila Golf
items.description_en: Golf course in the hills above Mijas Costa, with views down to the sea.
items.description_no: Golfbane i åsene over Mijas Costa, med utsikt ned mot havet.

items.name: Montenmedio Golf & Country Club
items.description_en: Course set among cork oaks and pine trees near Vejer de la Frontera, on an estate that is also known for its equestrian centre.
items.description_no: Bane blant korkeik og furu ved Vejer de la Frontera, på en eiendom som også er kjent for sitt ridesenter.

items.name: Islantilla Golf Resort
items.description_en: 27-hole resort course on the Huelva coast, close to the Portuguese border. A long drive from the house, so best combined with an overnight stay.
items.description_no: Resortbane med 27 hull på kysten av Huelva, nær grensen til Portugal. Lang kjøretur fra huset, så best kombinert med en overnatting.

items.name: Golf Campano
items.description_en: Course in Chiclana de la Frontera, south of Cádiz, close to the beaches of La Barrosa and Sancti Petri.
items.description_no: Bane i Chiclana de la Frontera sør for Cádiz, nær strendene La Barrosa og Sancti Petri.

items.name: Isla Canela Links
items.description_en: Links-style course at Isla Canela by Ayamonte, right at the Portuguese border. Sister course of Isla Canela Old Course. A long drive from the house, so best combined with an overnight stay.
items.description_no: Links-bane på Isla Canela ved Ayamonte, helt ved grensen til Portugal. Søsterbane til Isla Canela Old Course. Lang kjøretur fra huset, så best kombinert med en overnatting.

items.name: Los Arqueros Golf & Country Club
items.description_en: Par 71 course designed by Seve Ballesteros and opened in 1991, in the hills of Benahavís above Marbella. Hilly, with some blind shots and tricky greens.
items.description_no: Par 71-bane tegnet av Seve Ballesteros og åpnet i 1991, i åsene i Benahavís over Marbella. Kupert, med noen blinde slag og vanskelige greener.

items.name: Sancti Petri Hills Golf
items.description_en: Course in Novo Sancti Petri, Chiclana de la Frontera, near the long sandy beach of La Barrosa.
items.description_no: Bane i Novo Sancti Petri i Chiclana de la Frontera, nær den lange sandstranden La Barrosa.

items.name: Santa Clara Golf Marbella
items.description_en: Course on the east side of Marbella, close to the city.
items.description_no: Bane på østsiden av Marbella, like ved byen.

items.name: Villanueva Golf
items.description_en: Course in Puerto Real on the Bay of Cádiz.
items.description_no: Bane i Puerto Real ved Cádizbukta.

items.name: Barceló Montecastillo Golf
items.description_en: Jack Nicklaus-designed course in Jerez, next to the motor racing circuit. It has hosted the Volvo Masters on the European Tour.
items.description_no: Bane tegnet av Jack Nicklaus i Jerez, ved siden av motorsportbanen. Den har vært vertskap for Volvo Masters på European Tour.

items.name: Baviera Golf
items.description_en: 18-hole course designed by José María Cañizares at Caleta de Vélez, east of Málaga.
items.description_no: Bane med 18 hull tegnet av José María Cañizares i Caleta de Vélez, øst for Málaga.

items.name: Atalaya Golf, New Course
items.description_en: The New Course at Atalaya Golf & Country Club, between Estepona and Marbella. The club also has an Old Course.
items.description_no: New Course på Atalaya Golf & Country Club, mellom Estepona og Marbella. Klubben har også en Old Course.

items.name: Club de Golf Bellavista
items.description_en: Course in Aljaraque, just outside the city of Huelva. A long drive from the house, so best combined with an overnight stay.
items.description_no: Bane i Aljaraque, like utenfor byen Huelva. Lang kjøretur fra huset, så best kombinert med en overnatting.

items.name: Higuerón Marbella Golf Resort
items.description_en: Par 72 course by Robert Trent Jones Sr., opened in 1994 and formerly called Marbella Golf & Country Club. About 5 minutes from Marbella centre, with lakes on several holes.
items.description_no: Par 72-bane tegnet av Robert Trent Jones Sr., åpnet i 1994 og tidligere kalt Marbella Golf & Country Club. Ca. 5 minutter fra Marbella sentrum, med vann på flere hull.

items.name: La Monacilla Golf Club
items.description_en: Course in Aljaraque, just outside the city of Huelva. A long drive from the house, so best combined with an overnight stay.
items.description_no: Bane i Aljaraque, like utenfor byen Huelva. Lang kjøretur fra huset, så best kombinert med en overnatting.

items.name: Miguel Ángel Jiménez Golf
items.description_en: Golf course and academy named after the Spanish tour player, close to Málaga Airport.
items.description_no: Golfbane og akademi oppkalt etter den spanske tourspilleren, nær Málaga lufthavn.

items.name: Alhaurín Golf
items.description_en: Course designed by Seve Ballesteros in Alhaurín el Grande, in the Guadalhorce valley inland from Marbella.
items.description_no: Bane tegnet av Seve Ballesteros i Alhaurín el Grande, i Guadalhorce-dalen innenfor Marbella.

items.name: Añoreta Golf
items.description_en: Course in Rincón de la Victoria, east of Málaga, with views over the sea.
items.description_no: Bane i Rincón de la Victoria øst for Málaga, med utsikt over havet.

items.name: Benalmádena Golf
items.description_en: Small pitch & putt course in Benalmádena, good for a relaxed round or for practising the short game.
items.description_no: Liten pitch & putt-bane i Benalmádena, fin for en avslappet runde eller for å trene på det korte spillet.

items.name: Nuevo Portil Golf
items.description_en: Course among pine trees in Nuevo Portil near Cartaya, on the Huelva coast. A long drive from the house, so best combined with an overnight stay.
items.description_no: Bane blant furutrær i Nuevo Portil ved Cartaya, på kysten av Huelva. Lang kjøretur fra huset, så best kombinert med en overnatting.

items.name: Isla Canela Old Course
items.description_en: The original course at Isla Canela by Ayamonte, right at the Portuguese border. Sister course of Isla Canela Links. A long drive from the house, so best combined with an overnight stay.
items.description_no: Den opprinnelige banen på Isla Canela ved Ayamonte, helt ved grensen til Portugal. Søsterbane til Isla Canela Links. Lang kjøretur fra huset, så best kombinert med en overnatting.

items.name: La Estancia Golf
items.description_en: Course in Chiclana de la Frontera, south of Cádiz.
items.description_no: Bane i Chiclana de la Frontera, sør for Cádiz.

items.name: La Siesta Golf
items.description_en: Course in Calahonda, between Marbella and Fuengirola.
items.description_no: Bane i Calahonda, mellom Marbella og Fuengirola.

items.name: Villa Padierna – Tramores
items.description_en: Tramores is one of the three courses at Villa Padierna Golf Club in Benahavís, near the Anantara Villa Padierna Palace hotel.
items.description_no: Tramores er en av tre baner på Villa Padierna Golf Club i Benahavís, ved hotellet Anantara Villa Padierna Palace.

items.name: Antequera Golf
items.description_en: Inland course outside the historic town of Antequera, north of Málaga.
items.description_no: Innlandsbane utenfor den historiske byen Antequera, nord for Málaga.

items.name: Los Moriscos Club de Golf
items.description_en: Course by the sea at Playa Granada near Motril, on Granada's Costa Tropical.
items.description_no: Bane ved havet på Playa Granada ved Motril, på Costa Tropical i Granada.

items.name: Magna Marbella Golf
items.description_en: Course in Nueva Andalucía, Marbella's "Golf Valley", close to Puerto Banús.
items.description_no: Bane i Nueva Andalucía, Marbellas "Golf Valley", nær Puerto Banús.

items.name: Azata Golf
items.description_en: Course in Estepona, about half an hour from the house.
items.description_no: Bane i Estepona, ca. en halvtime fra huset.

items.name: Golf La Duquesa
items.description_en: Course designed by Robert Trent Jones Sr. in Manilva, above Puerto de la Duquesa, with views of the sea. One of the closest Golfamore courses to the house.
items.description_no: Bane tegnet av Robert Trent Jones Sr. i Manilva, over Puerto de la Duquesa, med utsikt mot havet. En av Golfamore-banene nærmest huset.

items.name: Arcos Golf
items.description_en: Par 72 course outside the white hill town of Arcos de la Frontera. It opened in 2006 as Arcos Gardens.
items.description_no: Par 72-bane utenfor den hvite fjellbyen Arcos de la Frontera. Den åpnet i 2006 under navnet Arcos Gardens.

items.name: Club de Golf Campo de Córdoba
items.description_en: 18-hole course in the hills about 8 km north of Córdoba. A long drive from the house, so best combined with an overnight stay.
items.description_no: Bane med 18 hull i åsene ca. 8 km nord for Córdoba. Lang kjøretur fra huset, så best kombinert med en overnatting.

items.name: San Roque Golf Resort, New Course
Almenara Golf Sotogrande
items.description_en: Sotogrande course that was known as Almenara Golf until it was renamed The Alto Club in 2025. It has an 18-hole par 71 course and a 9-hole par 3 academy course, and it's run by the SO/ Sotogrande hotel next door.
items.description_no: Bane i Sotogrande som het Almenara Golf frem til den fikk navnet The Alto Club i 2025. Den har en 18-hullsbane (par 71) og en akademibane med 9 par 3-hull, og drives av hotellet SO/ Sotogrande like ved.
